en: While similar in characteristics to the original model, this one has alternative markings to signify its belonging.
Worth noting that the wooden texture of this peace of costume doesn't reflect it's protective capabilities.
Mainly used by ^#20f080;yaara keeper^reset; hunters and protectors, it's looks are meant to defend, scare and disguise.
Mostly consisting of ^#299fc5;bionix^reset; and suspending materials, it provides a decent amount of protection for a guard.
Made from a high-quality material, this dress will make you the center of attention.
Its energy transceptors fuel your systems with enternia, resulting in a centralized protosystem.
Usually manufactured in batches, these are commonly sold in entertainment stores with small safety protocols, even if classified as non-lethal.
...Also it might be toxic so be careful.
Its pure silk material right from the ^#3587ff;blossoming ayakas^reset; stays well on the bionical alta skin.
Just like most trophy cosmetics, this wearable can often be left behind by a creature that looks similar to it.

Originally a navigation & fixation device developed by Astera researchers to be able to grab objects and hold certain constructions pressed against asteroids, with the removal of a **connector** between the ^#6f6c66;astera spear^reset; and the launcher, astera's tear became an efficient combat tool used by **astera scouts**.

**Spear Launchers** that go along with the spears are charge devices that create a kinetic ^#20f080;impulse^reset;, blasting the ^#6f6c66;astera spear^reset; forwards.
While not very protective, it's quite sturdy and can hold quite a lot of things.
The underlayered sweater is pretty worm and cozy, and is a bit softer compared to the regular researcher attire.
These fumes are made with aired ^#9b2d3f;warped honey^reset; for a thich texture and fresh ^#9b2d3f;yonnur^reset; for a bright glowing effect.
It provides a better visor with a broader scope and field of view. Similar models are used in many alta defence-related projects.
These masks are often worn by riverside scouts and are used to detect any small fire spreads in sight.
This unique model of a combat mask is made from a different composite of materials, and has a tiny visor opening for better defence.
Designed to provide additional visual context and protect vital parts of the head when facing an enemy.
The in-built emergency healing system is meant to protect the medic in case of unforseen circumstances.
Its full focus goes to reinforcing critical parts of the leg - feet and knees. This creates a good weight-defence balance.
It provides additional armor and step extendings to protect the legs and add weight to them.
Made with defence in mind, these greaves are designed to do everything possible to protect the wearer's legs and ensure their survival.
The visor in this helmet has an extended field of view to provide better clearance.
This dye imitates the shades of a piece of regular titanium, often used by the Miniknog.
Mobility with a reasonable level of defense creates a great balance useful during rapid combat.
If protects the head completely from all sides, providing a visor with small cameras on the sides for a combined field of view.
Its energy transceptors fuel your systems with stardust, resulting in a centralized protosystem.
Its energy transceptors fuel your systems with void, resulting in a centralized protosystem.
Its energy transceptors fuel your systems with celestial energy, resulting in a centralized protosystem.
Its energy transceptors fuel your systems with mixed stardust, resulting in a centralized protosystem.
The design is meant to protect the wearer with heat bursts and bost their movement at the same time.
Just like other pieces of alta laboratory attire, this one provides full body coverage with optional gloves to complete the set.
It can also be used in cooking after proper preparation, according to the ^#b0e0fc;calin cuisine book^reset;.
This cap-like metal headwear is supplied with a standardized ^#f02020;EDS visor^reset; module in place.
Similar to the ^#83a8a4;thermoscreen^reset;, this helmet is equipped with thermodetective technology.

This ^#f02080;Jinxies^reset; item looks exactly like a delicious treat, complete with a mouth-watering food tooltip. But appearances can be deceiving during Jinxies... Try to eat it, and watch what happens!
They are powered by the special protosystem that replaces usual energy cells with an energy circulation mechanic that flows troughout the whole costume.
They're part of the Protea's gift to inexperienced alta scouts as means of care and support!
This gift is part of Kora's relics, that she worn or used as the first security guard.

These hives can be grown like plants. Sometimes they can grow to enormous sizes, forming ^#9b2d3f;warped hive trees^reset;. These kinds of mutations are a natural process for all ^#9b2d3f;warped^reset; forms of life.

The hive seems is filled with delicious **warped honey**, often used by ^#b0e0fc;altas^reset; for cooking.

**NS-Hev**, or the **Energy Conderblock**, originally meant for converting excessive ^#8020f0;enternia^reset; into kinetic energy. With a proper **hevika charger**, can generate that energy itself for additional power.  
This prototype became popular with ^#b0e0fc;dreamers^reset;, which led to development of ^#8020f0;ion javelins^reset;.

This simple flare fires up this sparks of ^#8020f0;ionic^reset; energy from activating the ion-influenced ^#2080f0;alternia shard^reset; attached to a basic alta igniter. While shards themselves are pretty rare, this flare frovides impressive light time in response and can be used as ^#0050c0;hevika^reset;-type energy sources instead for example in ^#0050c0;Hevika Ordis^reset; furniture.

**Isoslime**, or **Izoslime**, or **Izopoi** - is a cryogenic slimy substance that tends to form in the subsurface (and rarely surface) layer of ^#2080f0;alterash prime^reset; planets. This substance is highly viscous and consists of two layers.  
The **outer** layer, or the **cryo layer**, is heat-isolation slime that protects the inner layer from low temperatures. This is a precious material that is often used by ^#b0e0fc;altas^reset; in construction.  
The **inner** layer, or the **poi layer**, consits of pure slime and is the main part of isoslime.

Isoslime is a subtype of regular ^#7ddcde;slime^reset;.
It utilizes particular types of ^#8080f0;vionia^reset; to create a point of immediate energy conflict.
It compensates lesser effect with mobility and protection, as well as a freen back slot.
A fireblast material is covering most of this chestpiece's surface to protect from dangerous environment.
The in-built emergency healing system is meant to protect the wearer in case of unforseen circumstances.
These leggings include multiple layers of high quality materials to ensure heat retention, electric isolation and poison blocks.
Perfect for special occasions and to hide your identity.
Enchanted eyes and a silent grin are the least disquieting aspects of this terrifying mask.
This floran relic can vary in shape and materials from tribe to tribe.
A symbol of patriotism and innocence, this flower is often worn by some ^#b0e0fc;alta social workers^reset; and ^#b0e0fc;alta caretakers^reset;.
It often growns as part of a felistraze bushes, that can grow up to 2 meters in height. You can often find 3-5 flowers per bush.
Often worn by nature-lowing altas, and those altas who're not afraid to put some ^#80f020;haven^reset; flowers on their head too.
Increases chances of being hugged by another alta by 500%. Which is mostly useless considering they are already at 90%.
Make from regular refined calin crystals, it might be a bit heavy to wear and needs some time getting used to.
Like many alta fasion items, this one was likely designed by ^#b0e0fc;Perizhad^reset;.
These are usually worn by supervisors and agents on space stations.
Very soft it the touch, it was sewed by Celestia herself to make an alta happy.

This is a piece of adapted kaiter technology, used as a defensive tactic against similar threats, but is mainly considered kaiter technology. While it doesn't create any radioactive waste with usage, it should be used sparingly to ensure alta safety.
This dye imitates the shades of a piece of refined alta titanium called "altan", as well as regular blue alta dye.

This is a cozy holiday scarf, hand-knitted by an alta. Soft, warm, and carrying that familiar holiday charm. During Sonaveil, altas exchange hand-knitted scarves like this one as tokens of warmth and friendship.
While not very practical, it's 100% eco-friendly and does provide a tiny lightsource.
Made from silk and eco-friendly compounds, it will serve you well for many years to come.
While not a very popular option for alta uniforms, it's a personal fashionable choice for many altas.
You can see tiny stardust particles radiate from inside it.
Most often than not it contains an artificial breathable compound gas (or ABCG for short), most compatible with altas.
Since many altas are used to playing and drawing with crayons in either Elin Gardens or CorFals (correctional facilities), this item might be more than familiar to them.
These are often seen on technical units, as well as alta androids.
This dye imitates the shades of a piece of bion compound, as well as regular bionic glow.
The wrist mechanisms are meant to be connected to any equiped proto-gear, like ^#b0e0fc;protospears^reset;, ^#b0e0fc;protomasks^reset; or even ^#b0e0fc;velocity eaters^reset;.
This gift is part of Protea's relics, that she worn or used as a scout.

Botanically speaking, this fruit is a nut. It has an outer semi-hard shell and a detached, soft white inside pulp, full of tonnova milk and nutrients.  
The pulp has a soft, slightly sweet taste that turns into a porrige-like taste during cooking. This is why **tonna porriges** are a thing and are quite popular in the ^#b0e0fc;nia cuisine^reset;.
To provide enough energy to power the entire range with its aura, the generator uses multiple energy cores in its blueprint.
They're part of the Kora's gift to inexperienced alta security guards as means of care and support!
This necessary life-saving technology is required for every security guard by safety protocols, but has to be worn separately from the suit.
Kora wore this supply not as much for herself - more so for other altas in need.
While it covers the head only partially, there are aerodynamic flexible membranes prtecting the rest of it and providing extra mobility.
Designed by... Wait, what? This helment wasn't designed by Perizhad. Wow. Well, thanks to "Viona's Surprize Shop" for such a find!
The life-saving techonlogy is powered by two main energy sources, one in the front, and one in the back, just in case.
While inferior in characteristics to the original model, this one is much lighter in size and allows better mobility.
This nade is classified as harmful by the blast equipment alta CEN, and yet it's made specifically to not be immediately lethal to altas. There are limits to everything, obviously.
No markings, a handmade casing and an amature mix of volatile ingredients that somehow resulted in something useful.
The technology behind it is meant to create a fast line of fire in a contained or outlined are to prevent it from spreading.
While being relatively easy to make, tthese skirts are often handmade and decorated by alta carftgirls and artists.
The material is pretty plain and was made to stay on well and not let most liquids get through it.
This dye imitates the shades of a piece of EDS armor, as well as regular red EDS dye.

A powerful discharge forces the crystal core to erupt, launching in different directions. This pressure-based self-eruption, or ^#378754;bishyn discharge^reset;, is what makes this device so useful in more than just combat.
The helmet itself provides enhanced vision in dimly lit and highly toxic and foggy environments, and has an in-built emergency protection system in case of depressurization.
This analytical alternia-powered protected headwear is a dream of many ^#b0e0fc;alta researchers^reset;, as there are quite a few comparable alternatives.
Its special built-in visor protects your eyes from direct light from nearby stars and disperces it, allowing you to see better in the dark spots.
This mask enhances the wearer's energy by connecting to the body suit's protogear system. The recepticles on the back are meant to gather that energy from the ionized air around.
This brings the gathered energy levels to a maximum, powering the whole protosystem almost instantly.

This beautifully hand-knitted scarf features lovely shades of lightblue and white. Crafted by skilled alta hands, it's both stylish and incredibly warm. These scarves are usually given out to travelers at alta outposts in colder regions, as a rule of hospitality and care.
